title: ceramic asian soup bowls with matching spoons
text: ceramic asian soup bowls with matching spoons. These are really beautiful bowls and work well with ramen or other style soups.  The spoon hangs on one of the handles.  The lid is nice for presentation.  Mine arrived whole and in good condition along with other items I had ordered. They are ceramic, but washed beautifully on the top rack of my dishwasher.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: ECODECO Bake & Serve - Large Ceramic Soup Bowls With Handles - 30 Ounce - Set of 2 - Oven-, Microwave and Dishwasher Safe Pots with Lids
features: Set of 2 bowls: 2 Asian soup crocks with spoons and matching lids. Height (with lid) - 5.25", Bottom Diameter - 3.5", Top Diameter with handles - 8";
Dishwasher-, Microwave- and Oven-safe up to 400 F. Put your bowls in a cold or warm oven - ceramic bowls should be heated gradually. Not for use on a stove-top;
The lid keeps the content juicy and warm. Soup and stew cooked in a ceramic crock pot with the lid retain flavor and healthy ingredient;

Traditional shape complements Ramen, Udon, Noodle, Wonton soup, Rice, Pho, and Soba. The bowls are also great for cooking and serving hot winter soups, stew, pasta, chili and any dish cooked in the oven;

description: The set of 2 Asian soup bowls with lids is a lovely addition to your kitchen!  Serve your delicious soup using these handled Asian style crocks. Lids will keep the content warm and juicy. Soup and stew cooked in a ceramic crock pot with the lid retain flavor and healthy ingredients.
These big microwavable crocks hold up to 30 ounces of your favorite meal. These bowls are made of high-quality stoneware ceramic.

Large size & distinctive design make these cooking pots ideal for serving Asian style meals such as Pho, Soba, Ramen, Wonton soup and rice. Also great for Salads, Spaghetti, Cereal, Oatmeal, Stews, Chili, Casserole, Cobblers, French Onion soup and more!
